name: Wand of Wonder
clause: Each opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile an instant or sorcery card, then shuffles the rest into their library.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'exile-until', who: ScopeWho, from: 'library', filter: Filter, rest: 'shuffle-into-library' | 'library-bottom' | 'graveyard' }
needs.semantics: Each named player exiles cards from the top of their library one at a time until they exile a card matching `filter` (or the library is empty), then does `rest` with the non-matching cards. Binds the matching cards as `those` so a following effect can cast or move them.
